facts.fact: Pazhayangadi (Thulasi's home village) has been burned by the Thurai landing; Kalladi is holding with about a hundred raiders on the road.
Devan estimates the raiders will reach the Monkey Pass gorge, forty paces wide, in three days.
Muthu reads the crown's order from the gate chamber stair: the crown holds Kodiyur and the forts, the garrison stays inside the walls, and the hill villages bear what comes.

Devan puts his leave to go down and hold the gorge to the Company's vote and binds himself to it ('If the hands say no, I sit by this fire and hate it'). Vellan and Thilak volunteer after the vote is carried.
The resin vote: forty-two odiyans (the forty, Neela and Vellan); twenty-seven hands for an even split, eleven for the other plan, four abstain. The four abstainers get their pinch first.
Kesu's grandson's mother waits at the foot of the goat path with the goats; Kesu stays to hold the well.
First Guard is a few years past thirty, wears a green sash at the left hip, climbs alone with open hands and sleeves pulled to the knuckles. Her left wrist shows a single pared-flat seam.
